DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center. EDSA comer Quezon Avenue. west Triangle, Quezon City http: dilg.gov.ph 1 JAN ATTY. JESUS FRANCO B. LASQUITE City Legal Officer Calapan City, Oriental Mindoro Dear Atty. Lasquite: S. This has reference to your 28 October 2016 letter requesting for an authority to practice your profession as a lawyer in accordance with the limitations set in the DILG Circular No. 2016-14 and other pertinent rules and regulations under Civil Service Law and Republic Act no. 6713 otherwise known as "The Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees". As represented, City Mayor Arnan C. Panaligan had already given you an authority to practice profession. In reply thereto, please be informed that CSC Resolution No. 92-2203, dated 21 June 1993, the Civil Service Commission has in effect resolved that government lawyers could engage in the private practice of their profession upon prior authority from the head of agency under which he/she is appointed. In your case, the head of the agency insofar as your position as City Legal Officer is concerned is the City Mayor. Hence, the authority to practice previously given to you by the Mayor would already suffice. Although the aforesaid CSC Resolution did not set the conditions underwhich the authority to engage in the private practice of law may be granted, it is understood that the limitations setforth under the Civil Service Laws and RA No.6713 shall always be observed. Normally, it is granted on the condition that his duty as a public servant must not be prejudiced. Thus, in case of conflict of schedule, his duty as a public servant always takes precedence. Further, DILG Circular No. 2016- 14 is not applicable in your case. Please be advised that Circular is issued to cover administrative instructions which are directly or informative in nature more or less permanent in duration, requiring compliance by or

information of all DILG Personnel (Central, Regional and Field Offices). (DILG Circular No. 2016-06 dated March 9, 2016). We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very ly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary - OUSLG 2 01 01-16-002@
